items.text: MATERIAL: ALUMINUM, PLATE, 6061-T6, IN ACCORDANCE WITH ASTM B205.
FINISH: CHROMATE CONVERSION COATING IN ACCORDANCE WITH MIL-DTL-5541, CLASS 1A, TYPE II.
IDENTIFICATION MARKING SHALL BE LOCATED APPROXIMATELY WHERE SHOWN IN ACCORDANCE WITH MIL-STD-130.
UNLESS OTHERWISE SPECIFIED, ALL BASIC DIMENSION SURFACES SHALL COMPLY WITH: ⌓|.016|A|B|C.

WHEN THE FLATNESS OF DATUM FEATURE A EXCEEDS THE STATED PROFILE TOLERANCE IN THE FREE STATE, THE FEATURE MAY BE RESTRAINED TO DATUM PLANE A WITHIN THE SPECIFIED PROFILE TOLERANCE VALUE. THE ITEM SHALL BE DEEMED ACCEPTABLE WHEN FEATURES RELATED TO DATUM A MEET TOLERANCE REQUIREMENTS IN THIS RESTRAINED STATE.

doubts: k4: note 4 holds a profile frame (⌓|.016|A|B|C) as the default for all basic dimensions; kept as one note item, an app may list the frame as its own gdt_frame
k5: note 5 is a restraint condition for inspection, not a measured characteristic; included as a note because it governs acceptance
Excluded: note 6 (inches, interpret per ASME Y14.5-2009) and note 7 (parentheses are reference only); both impose no inspectable requirement
No UNLESS OTHERWISE SPECIFIED tolerance block in the title block; sheet has notes and reference views only
